conditions: two familiar source groupings are evaluated separately and then in an explicit combined form
task: rate graded membership for each component grouping and for their combined grouping

nodes.description: graded membership response for the first component grouping
graded membership response for the second component grouping
compensatory weighted or multiplicative averaging transform applied to the two component responses
graded response assigned to the combined grouping
decision boundary applied to the graded combined representation to classify membership
procedure obtaining component judgments before judgments of the combined grouping

relations.description: the two component ratings are transformed by a compensatory averaging rule into the combined rating
classification is determined by comparing the graded combined response with the decision boundary
component responses predict combined responses with systematic compensation, including positive classifications when one component alone falls below its boundary
the staged probe supplies the component and combined responses used to estimate the transform
